risk_note: F1-08ce (orchestrator D10-1731 / D10-1732 / D10-1734 / D10-1808; landed per D10-1772, stacked on #191 F1-08cb and rebased onto main). Admin adjustments create and reversal: a submit that gets no reply in the unified envelope (network error, unparsable reply) enters a result-unknown state that keeps the original Idempotency-Key and request body, locks every input and removes the submit button; only 重试 (original key, byte-identical body) and 去列表核对 (close and refresh the list) remain, with 上次提交结果未知; the form unlocks only after a definite result; reopening create refreshes the list first; no second click can send a different body or a new key (D10-1731). The success prompt shows the available balance before and after (D10-1732); amounts only through @couli/money. This lifts the D10-1734 release guard set by #191. Eight blocks of the frozen F1-08cb tests change their expectations (ERROR#4 drops the network-down reply; seven success prompts gain the before / after balance lines); they are registered as modify_existing in ledger patch #195 and, per D10-1670 / D10-1808, need the owner's own confirmation before the owner-approved label. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context); another independent Claude spec-test pass (its first output was rejected by the validator for the out_of_scope key format and rerun). Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); couli-ci verify:fast run 1 and --browser run 1 green before the final rebase. Written by hand. The owner confirmed the eight changed expectations on 2026-11-16 (D10-1819). Afterwards (D10-1812) one new it block was added at the end of each of the four changed frozen files ([AC-F1-08ce-NEW#1]-[#4]), red on the base for an assertion, reviewed by a third spec-test of the new blocks only (approvals #96); the eight blocks and the code outside the tests are unchanged since 7ff400378943.

reviews.note: Codex out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604): money review by an independent Claude per ops/approvals.yaml #36 (claude-run.sh, fresh context), r1 pass, 0 S2
